name: Hibisu Mairu
source:
3rd year student at Cherry Tree High & heroine of CTHCC!
A lively young girl who just wants see people being happy, Miley works hard at her schtick to make people laugh.
Miley has a reputation around school of being a reckless eccentric, but her infectious positivity allows her to goof about with all types of people – guys and girls, old and young!
She can’t resist helping people who are in trouble.
